title: Mangrove Loss Slowed 45% Even As Forests Shrunk
hook: Mangrove loss slowed 45%, but coastlines still lost protection.
closing: Slower loss proves protection works, but every missing mangrove leaves coastlines more exposed.
question: Can mangrove protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove area fell to 15.2 million hectares, shrinking a natural barrier against coastal storms.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, the largest regional decline shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed 45%, proving protection can reduce destruction before it stops it.
